title: Entrance Exam Calendar 2026-27
intro_short: The exams that matter most after Class 12 — application windows, exam dates and official websites, each clearly labelled so no expected date is mistaken for an official one.
intro_full: This calendar covers the major entrance and recruitment examinations for the 2026-27 season, in one place. Every entry shows what is happening (application window, exam date, result timing) and carries one of three labels: CONFIRMED means an official notification or exam calendar has announced it; EXPECTED means it is projected from the previous cycle and can still change; NOT ANNOUNCED means no official date exists yet. The calendar is refreshed every Monday from official sources — NTA, UPSC, SSC, RRB, CBSE, ICAI and state boards. Use it to plan applications, not as a substitute for the official notification.

sections.heading: Apply now — urgent deadlines
sections.body: Application windows that are open or closing in the coming weeks. Check the official website before the last date.

items.title: CLAT 2027 (Consortium of NLUs)
items.body: Application window is open for the Common Law Admission Test. The exam is a two-hour paper held in the afternoon.
items.meta: Apply by 31 Oct 2026 | Exam 6 Dec 2026 | CONFIRMED (official)

items.title: RRB NTPC 2026 (Graduate and Undergraduate)
items.body: Two separate application windows for graduate and undergraduate posts, as per the official indicative notice.
items.meta: Graduate: 8 Oct – 6 Nov 2026 | UG: 15 Oct – 13 Nov 2026 | CONFIRMED (official notice)

items.title: UGC NET December 2026 cycle
items.body: The exam dates are published in the NTA calendar, but the notification and application window had not been released at the time of the last update.

items.title: CTET 2026 (CBSE, 22nd edition)
items.body: The Central Teacher Eligibility Test will be held over two days. Applications for this cycle are already closed.

items.title: NDA (I) and CDS (I) 2027 (UPSC)
items.body: Notification and application window for the first NDA and CDS exams of 2027, per the UPSC calendar.
items.meta: Apply 2–22 Dec 2026 | Exam 11 Apr 2027 | CONFIRMED (UPSC calendar)

items.title: CA Foundation, January 2027 cycle
items.body: Exam form window opens in November, with a late-fee window; the exam runs over four days in early January.

items.title: UPSSSC PET 2026
items.body: Preliminary Eligibility Test for Uttar Pradesh government posts, held in two shifts per day on the revised schedule.
items.meta: Exam 25 Oct, 30 Oct and 1 Nov 2026 | CONFIRMED (official, revised)

items.title: CAT 2026 (IIM Indore)
items.body: The Common Admission Test for MBA admissions. Registration for this cycle has closed.

sections.heading: After Class 12 — Medical and Engineering
sections.body: The two biggest streams after Class 12. NEET UG 2027 will shift to a computer-based test — an officially announced change.

items.title: NEET UG 2027
items.body: The notification is expected in February 2027, with the exam expected in early May. The Education Ministry has officially announced that NEET UG 2027 will be computer-based, conducted over five to six days — replacing the pen-and-paper format.
items.meta: Notification EXPECTED Feb 2027 | Exam NOT ANNOUNCED (early May 2027 expected) | CBT format CONFIRMED

items.title: JEE Main 2027 (Session 1)
items.body: Session 1 dates are published in the official NTA exam calendar. Registration had not opened at the last update.
items.meta: Exam 22, 23, 24, 28, 29, 30 Jan 2027 | Registration NOT ANNOUNCED | CONFIRMED (NTA calendar)

items.title: JEE Main 2027 (Session 2)
items.body: The second session is expected in April 2027; exact dates are not yet published.

items.title: JEE Advanced 2027
items.body: Open to the top JEE Main qualifiers. The official schedule is expected around December 2026; press reports point to mid-May 2027 but treat any specific date as indicative.

sections.heading: After Class 12 — Law, Management and Defence
sections.body: Law, business and defence entries beyond the science streams.

items.title: CLAT 2027
items.body: National law entrance for the 22 National Law Universities and several private law schools.
items.meta: Apply by 31 Oct 2026 | Exam 6 Dec 2026 | CONFIRMED (official)

items.title: CAT 2026
items.body: Gateway to the IIMs and most top MBA programmes. Registration closed on 22 September 2026.

items.title: NDA and CDS (I) 2027
items.body: Defence entry after Class 12 (NDA) and after graduation (CDS), conducted by UPSC.
items.meta: Apply 2–22 Dec 2026 | Exam 11 Apr 2027 | CONFIRMED (UPSC calendar)

sections.heading: Teaching and government jobs
sections.body: Recruitment examinations for teaching and central or state government posts.

items.title: CTET 2026
items.body: Eligibility test for teaching in central government schools; required by many state recruitment boards too.

items.title: UGC NET (December 2026)
items.body: Qualifies candidates for assistant professor and junior research fellowship roles; exam dates are published, application awaited.

items.title: SSC CGL 2026
items.body: Combined Graduate Level examination for central government posts. Tier-1 is being held in this window; Tier-2 is expected in December.

items.title: SSC CHSL 2026
items.body: For 10+2 level central government posts. The Tier-1 window has been notified; exact shift dates appear on the admit card.

items.title: RRB NTPC 2026
items.body: Railway recruitment for graduate and undergraduate posts across zones. Exam dates are not yet announced.

items.title: UPSSSC PET 2026
items.body: Preliminary test that qualifies candidates for a wide range of Uttar Pradesh government recruitments.
items.meta: Exam 25 Oct, 30 Oct and 1 Nov 2026 | CONFIRMED (official)

sections.heading: How to read the labels
sections.body: Every date in this calendar carries one of three labels. Please treat them differently.

items.title: CONFIRMED
items.body: Announced by the conducting body — NTA, UPSC, SSC, RRB, CBSE, ICAI or a state board — in an official notification or exam calendar. Note that NTA and UPSC calendars carry the caveat that dates are tentative and can be altered.

items.title: EXPECTED
items.body: Projected from the previous cycle's pattern. Useful for planning, but it is not a promise and can shift.

items.title: NOT ANNOUNCED
items.body: No official date exists yet. Any specific date circulating on social media or coaching pages should not be treated as fact.

items.title: Refreshed every Monday
items.body: This calendar is updated from official sources every Monday. If you are reading it on a later date, verify the current position on the official website before applying.
items.meta: Check the official website before applying
